current_date: 22 May 2025 (adopted, per document text quoted in Grokbot's extraction)
current_evidence: The council's Local Requirements List page links only this 'GBC Local Requirements List May 2025.docx' and mentions no newer version or consultation.

issues.detail: All 24 requirements are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', but the list has a matrix by application type. Householder should include, conditionally, Ecology, CIL forms, Daylight/Sunlight (45-degree line), Design Code checklist, FRA (Zones 2/3), Green Belt calculations, Heritage Statement, Parking provision and Tree survey. Outline and Reserved Matters also carry many items (e.g. Design Code checklist, Landscaping, Lighting, SCI for RM). Listed building consent carries Joinery details and Structural Survey. Hedgerow removal carries Ecology and Tree survey.
issues.evidence: Requirements matrix (columns HH, NB, RC, CNR, CoU, AG, OUT, RM, LBC, HR) in Appendix 1 Local Requirements List as amended

issues.detail: Missing local requirements: CIL forms (net increase over 100 sqm residential/retail, or a new dwelling/annex); Environmental statement / land contamination Phase I-III (where contamination is possible from former use); Green Belt calculations (Green Belt PDL housing, conversions, commercial, householder); Joinery details (LBC for new/replacement windows, doors, mouldings, shopfronts); Landscaping details (ecologically or visually sensitive sites); Low Carbon Planning Guidance statement (10+ dwellings or commercial of 1ha / 1,000 sqm or more); Parking provision (where existing parking is altered); Planning Statement (majors and departures); Site Waste Management Plan (all new residential, plus commercial generating waste; bin storage on plan); Statement of Community Involvement (where pre-app community consultation took place); Ventilation/Extraction statement (new ventilation/extraction). The Design Code checklist appears only as a tab item, with no app-type row.

Several triggers are text fragments. Transport Assessment quotes the document introduction ('Appendix 1 - Transport Statement Thresholds 60 Introduction This Local Requirements List was adopted...') instead of the Appendix 1 thresholds. Coal Mining starts with 'Draft Heads of Terms for S106 if required'. Noise quotes 'This document can be viewed at:-'. Flood Risk gives only 'must be written by a suitably qualified person' instead of Flood Zones 2/3, Zone 1 sites over 1ha or 10+ dwellings. Lighting gives 'must include:-' instead of 'where floodlighting is proposed'. Travel Plan omits the over-50-units threshold. Biodiversity Checklist is a cross-reference sentence.
issues.evidence: Source: Travel Plan 'developments over 50 units'; FRA 'Flood Zone 1 ... over 1 ha ... 10+ dwellings'; Lighting 'where floodlighting is proposed'

issues.detail: The Floor plans/Elevations row uses '1:5 elevations with 1:2 sections', which comes from the joinery details guidance (LBC). The Heritage Statement trigger quotes only the archaeology sentence instead of 'development affecting a heritage asset'. The Telecommunications row quotes aerodrome notification text, not a local requirement trigger.
issues.evidence: 'at 1:5 elevations with 1:2 sections.'; 'Heritage Impact Assessment will need to cover any archaeological issues at the site.'

issues.detail: Several 'Drawing / document standards' tab items are fragments of guidance inside other requirements (drainage plan content, landscaping plan scales, a repair/rebuild annotation sentence) rather than standalone requirements.
issues.evidence: 'This should be accompanied annotated plans to show the extent of any repair or re-build works as appropriate.'

summary: The link is the current May 2025 list (adopted 22 May 2025), but Grokbot put every requirement under Full planning, missed about 11 local requirements, and has several triggers taken from the wrong part of the document. I checked the contents against the January 2024 amended draft because the .docx could not be read.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The list date is recorded as 2025-05-01, but the document text says it was adopted on 22 May 2025.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: 'This Local Requirements List was adopted by Gedling Borough Council on 22nd May 2025'
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The workbook records list dates at month precision by convention. 2025-05-01 correctly reflects the 22 May 2025 adoption, and Date_basis quotes that exact text.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The workbook stores list dates to the month, so the value is right; only the date-basis label could be better. Not a Grokbot error.

withdrawn_issues.detail: Caveat: WebFetch could not read the .docx (binary), so I compared contents against the council's 'Appendix 1 - Local Requirements List as Amended' (draft January 2024, Cabinet papers), which is very likely the basis of the May 2025 adopted list. Differences in the final May 2025 text were not verified.
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: This is an auditor limitation, not a workbook issue. The May 2025 .docx text is captured in raw (74d9632e5a: 'Local Requirements List May 2025'), so a comparison against the final text was possible.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. This was a note about what my helpers could not read, not a Grokbot error, so it is removed from the issue counts. The council stays on "Still to check by hand".
